decision: Reject as default: neither workload has a repeatable gain across six alternating pairs. Production runtime unchanged.
design: Optional second native entry repeats a conditional backedge to the same block, retaining cached host GPRs. Soft 64-instruction budget and logical block counts preserve existing batch/control cadence. Memory iterations revalidate fetch page and code generation; declines and early exits return accumulated instruction prefixes before interpreter replay. Public run() keeps single-block behavior.
